text:
Maya: quick sync on playground streaming UI. new proposal: compact token pill top-right, a single action that morphs from "Stop generation" -> "Re-run", and move prompt library into a collapsible drawer (bottom sheet on mobile). mock: https://figma.redwood/play-stream-v5
Jon: I like the single action morph. fewer buttons = less noise. question: how do people discover token counts? tiny pill might be missed. suggestion: show pill + small inline delta next to each assistant message (+8) that fades after 6s.
Sofia: accessibility: aria-live needs to be handled carefully. streaming partials should be announced with polite and a short summary only, avoid spamming screen readers. also ensure the token pill is reachable via keyboard and has a clear aria-label like "Message token usage: 12 tokens".
Akarsh: backend note: we can emit token-estimate events at intervals (every 200ms) but that's noisy. better: estimate in-client from bytes, then reconcile with server final delta. will add a metric for "estimate->final deviation".
Maya: good point. copy nits: prefer "Re-run" over "Regenerate"? shorter and consistent with other UIs. also show shorthand tooltip "tokens used" on hover.
Jon: keyboard shortcuts: propose Escape = stop, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter = run/re-run, Shift+Alt+P = open prompt library. call out conflicts in docs.
Sofia: contrast check: token pill foreground in light theme must be >=4.5:1. current purple token chips fail in dark. I'll attach updated color tokens.
DesignBot: uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/figma/stream-v5.png (image) :white_check_mark:
Akarsh: error flows: if Stop cancels, server returns 499 + body {"partial": true, "tokens": 6}. client should show a subtle divider with "Stopped (partial output)" and token delta. also handle 429/503 with a retry suggestion.
Maya: UI interaction detail: while streaming the action is prominent with red outline and label "Stop generation". when stopped or finished it becomes primary blue "Re-run". pressing Re-run should bring up a small confirmation if the previous run consumed >1000 tokens.
Jon: mobile: bottom sheet for prompt library, token pill floats above composer. minimal obstruction is key. swiping the pill could toggle a compact breakdown panel. maybe too fancy for v1.
Sofia: focus management: when drawer opens focus should go to first prompt card and pressing Escape closes and returns focus to composer. add visible focus ring for low-vision users.
Akarsh: telemetry: track events: playground.run, playground.stop, playground.re_run, prompt.insert, token.charge_estimate, token.charge_final. include payload with model, token_count_estimate, token_count_final.
Maya: let's do a 6-person quick user test: tasks: stop mid-stream, check token info, insert pinned prompt. Noah, can you run it?
Jon: small code snippet for server cancel handler we discussed:
```
app.post('/generate', async (req, res) => {
  const stream = startGen(req.body);
  req.on('close', () => stream.cancel());
});
```
Sofia: also make sure aria-hidden is toggled for background content when drawer opens for screen readers.
DesignBot: comment: updated figma + contrast matrix uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/stream-v5-contrast.csv
Akarsh: I'll spec API endpoints: GET /api/playground/prompts, POST /api/playground/prompts/pin, POST /api/generate/cancel.
Maya: great. I'll update the figma and the component doc with variants (streaming/finished/error) and post a short Loom of the interaction. will follow up after the usability test. :thumbsup:
